Judge CLIs and browser: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (diff: SAME) and pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22) and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31); Chromium is installed by @playwright/mcp's own bundled playwright CLI (lines 33-38) and every judge.toml launches playwright-mcp with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (line 12). Registry check (`npm view @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 dependencies`) shows exact pins playwright/playwright-core 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05, so the Chromium build is determined by the pinned MCP version. Shared tools: tests/tools/score.py (sha256 13de2b38...) and restart_mcp.py (03c1426f...) are identical to the frozen template copies; tests/test.sh and scoring.toml also identical. Fixed clock: no graded rule depends on the run date. The only graded time rules are relative latency windows ('within 15 seconds' in hireops_rules.md:117 and functional/polish criteria e.g. scored/functional/judge.toml:308,344,353,362; polish judge.toml:23,32), measured from the judge's own action, independent of calendar date. Seed timestamps are fixed constants (130 ISO dates, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:07:00Z) in environment/assets/seed_data.json; there is no expiry, 'today', relative-age display or deadline anywhere in instruction, rules, app_context or criteria; activity/messages ordering created at run time (index.js:59 now()) always post-dates the seed. test.sh's only date use is a log line (line 178). Network: public; no allowlist, which the workbook marks NOT a defect. Runtime: raw-evidence-index scripted golden run (hash-verified) drove /usr/local/bin/chromium via the pinned MCP playwright inside the verifier image (workspace.cjs:6,287), showing the pinned browser path resolves; it is not a configured judge run. Adversarial: a broken app cannot exploit pinning (it affects only the grader); a conforming app that stamps messages with the wall clock or a different time zone still passes because no criterion reads absolute times. Notes (not defects, template-controlled): base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) not digest-pinned and apt packages unpinned (NOTE per check-dockerfiles.py); OpenRouter provider routing for the model slug is outside task control; LLM judge output is inherently stochastic and temperature is explicitly not required.
